specification.title: Entities beyond the depth limit are never pivoted
specification.description: A discovered entity beyond max_depth never becomes a pivot.
specification.purpose: Verify a discovered entity past max_depth is never turned into a pivot and the stop reason reflects the depth limit.
specification.operational_relevance: Depth bounds keep investigations from expanding indefinitely through nested infrastructure.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could pivot a deep entity and violate the depth budget, or stop with the wrong reason.

required: The deep entity never appears as a pivot
forbidden: A pivot executes beyond the maximum investigation depth
